settings.title: What visitors ask about iconic photo spots

tabs.tab_title: Where can I photograph Zion without a long hike?
tabs.tab_content: Look at legal, signed scenic viewpoints and the visitor-center/Pa'rus corridor. Do not assume any road shoulder is a permitted stop.

tabs.tab_title: Is Canyon Overlook suitable for everybody?
tabs.tab_content: No. The short route contains exposed sections. Visitors should compare terrain and group mobility with official trail descriptions.

tabs.tab_title: Can I photograph wildlife up close?
tabs.tab_content: Use a safe distance and never approach or feed animals for a photograph.
Check NPS regulations before bringing or operating any unmanned aircraft; do not assume recreational drones are permitted in a national park.
